scope: Descriptive reanalysis of existing full saved predictions; no fitting, selection, weight changes, GPU work, or new confirmation.
pairing: Exact original and channel-wise index, source_row, target and complete profile identities; registered source hashes and model settings verified before metrics.
retained_rows: All stored evaluation endpoints, contiguous profile indices 300 through original row count minus one.
partition: For fifth b in 0..4, half-open retained-array bounds floor(n*b/5) to floor(n*(b+1)/5).
statistic: Within each profile compute each arm's RMSE on the same fifth. Average own_boundary minus original differences equally across every profile in the cohort. Also retain arm-specific macro and pooled RMSE.
plot: Five cohort panels, three methods, all five fifths, zero line. Negative differences favor channel-wise initialization. IPMSM and Paderborn panels may use different stated y ranges to retain legibility.
interpretation: Retained-row fifths are not equal physical durations. Comparing refitted procedures does not recover physical rotor initial temperature. All records were previously exposed, and small-cohort results are descriptive.

_public_view.transformation: JSON reserialization with this provenance notice; scientific values and original historical receipt hashes retained. Source-record paths are relative and refer to private archived inputs, not bundled raw data.
_public_view.receipt_scope: Historical archival record, not evidence that the current portable release script was executed. Current release checks are recorded separately in provenance/validation-v007.json.
